T: You'll believe a man can fly. And cook.
D: A baby from Krypton grows up to become Superman in Metropolis.
P: Serve the mains when Superman catches Lois on the helicopter.
S: Boiled then grilled corn rolled in butter, sea salt and smoked paprika
Corn boiled 5 minutes, charred on a grill, rolled in butter, salt and a little smoked paprika.
Perry White's newsroom running on sugar

Fluffy yeasted doughnuts fried golden and dipped in a vanilla glaze, half finished with red and blue sprinkles for the man in the cape. Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg and mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 10 rings and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp milk and 1 tsp vanilla, dip the warm doughnuts and finish half with red and blue sprinkles.
Firm lime jelly cut into jagged shards, served with whipped cream
Lime jelly made firm with extra gelatine, set in a slab, cut into jagged crystal shards, piled on a plate with whipped cream.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Mashed potato and gravy.

Lobster meat folded through a rich sauce of shallot, white wine, cream, Dijon and gruyère, piled back into the shells and grilled bubbling and golden. Halve 2 cooked lobsters lengthways, remove the meat and cut into chunks, keeping the shells. Soften 2 finely chopped shallots in 30g butter, add 100ml white wine and reduce by half. Stir in 200ml cream and 1 tsp Dijon and simmer 3 minutes until thick, then add 60g grated gruyère and the lobster. Spoon back into the shells, top with 30g more gruyère and grill 4 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon and a green salad.
W: Tall crisp meringue crystals dusted with edible glitter
Swiss meringue piped into tall jagged crystal shapes, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Iced espresso latte with malt, topped with whipped cream and cocoa

Espresso shaken with malted milk syrup and poured over ice and cold milk, topped with sweet cold foam and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 4 shots espresso. Stir 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved, then cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the coffee over. Whisk 100ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar until just thick but pourable, spoon on top and dust with cocoa.

note.text: I'm filing the story and Clark is buying lunch. He just doesn't know it yet.

winks: Lex Luthor's lair below the city

dishes.make_ahead: Boil the corn up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; char on the grill and butter just before serving

steps.text: Boil the corn.
Char on a hot grill, turning.
Cut each cob in half, roll in the butter and sprinkle with salt and smoked paprika.
Soften the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Dissolve the jelly crystals in the boiling water and stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Pour into a lined slab tin and chill until firm.
Cut into jagged shards, pile on a plate and serve with whipped cream.
Whisk the agar into the water in a saucepan and boil, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Take off the heat and whisk in the jelly crystals until dissolved.
Pour into a lined slab tin, cool, then chill until firm.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Cut the jelly into jagged shards, pile on a plate and serve with the whipped cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chicken the day before

steps.text: Soak the chicken overnight in the buttermilk and salt.
Dredge in the flour seasoned with the paprika and black pepper.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 165C in batches until 74C inside.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Make gravy from a little of the frying fat, flour and the stock.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in the buttermilk and salt for 1 hour.
Mix the flour with the paprika and pepper and dredge the cauliflower in it.
Fry at 175C in the oil in batches until deep golden and tender.
Boil the potatoes and mash with 30 g of the butter and the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in 2 tbsp of the seasoned flour and whisk in the stock to make gravy.
Whisk the egg whites and sugar in a bowl over simmering water until the sugar dissolves.
Whisk off the heat with the cream of tartar until stiff and glossy.
Pipe tall jagged crystal shapes on lined trays.
Bake at 100C and cool in the oven.
Dust with edible glitter.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew, sweeten and cool the malted espresso up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; pour over ice and milk and top with the cream just before serving

steps.text: Brew the espresso, stir in the malt and sugar until dissolved and cool.
Fill four glasses with ice and cold milk, then pour the coffee over.
Whisk the cream with the icing sugar until just thick but pourable, spoon on top and dust with cocoa.

s.note: Boiled then grilled corn rolled in butter, sea salt and smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 5 minutes, then char on a hot grill for 5 minutes, turning. Cut each cob in half. Roll in 40g softened butter and sprinkle with sea salt flakes and 1 tsp smoked paprika.

s.note: Firm lime jelly cut into jagged shards, served with whipped cream
s.how: Make 2 packets of lime jelly crystals with 400ml boiling water instead of the usual amount, adding 2 softened gelatine leaves to set it firm. Pour into a lined slab tin and chill 4 hours. Cut into jagged crystal shards, pile on a plate and serve with 200ml whipped thickened cream.

m.note: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy
m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt. Dredge in 200g flour seasoned with paprika and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Boil 800g potatoes, mash with butter and milk. Make gravy with 2 tbsp of the fat, 2 tbsp flour and 400ml chicken stock.

w.note: Tall crisp meringue crystals dusted with edible glitter
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites and 220g caster sugar in a bowl over simmering water until the sugar dissolves, then whisk off the heat with 1/4 tsp cream of tartar until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall jagged crystal shapes on lined trays and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool in the oven and dust with edible glitter.

d.note: Iced espresso latte with malt, topped with whipped cream and cocoa
d.how: Brew 4 shots espresso. Stir 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved, then cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the coffee over. Whisk 100ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar until just thick but pourable, spoon on top and dust with cocoa.
